scope.responsibility: Localize the owned day-review copy while preserving the captured review and its operational guards

implementation.copy: Private branded descriptors and WeakMap bindings; foreign pool/client names, notes, errors and provider summaries remain literal. No enumerable metadata added to buildReview output. Default Portuguese shape and semantics preserved.
implementation.repaint: Real language picker and silent document language changes repaint connected owned nodes. The language picker input does not invalidate a review; operational input and original events still do. No reread of providers/server/storage to translate.
implementation.timestamps: Capture review and route timestamps once, then only format them in the selected locale. Test advances the browser clock by one hour during repaint and requires the original Portuguese stamp after the round trip.
implementation.guards: Physical water/pump responsibility, typed regular/extra identity, pending/unknown/critical classification, offline uncertainty, incomplete server response, corrupt data, revision and account/token checks preserved.
